reason: The lab report for my batch and the money-back thing take the sting out of it, and $24.99 for one box is an impulse amount if a video hits my sleep problem. The sachet means I might actually take it instead of leaving it in the drawer with the others.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, and the guarantee only works if I finish all 30 sachets.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust showing real results after a few weeks, or a guarantee that lets me ask for a refund before finishing the whole box.
